system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: cloud-armor-security-policy
  type: gcp-types/compute-beta:securityPolicies
  properties:
    description: "Production Cloud Armor security policy with geo-blocking and rate limiting"
    type: CLOUD_ARMOR
    adaptiveProtectionConfig:
      layer7DdosDefenseConfig:
        enable: true
        ruleVisibility: STANDARD
    advancedOptionsConfig:
      jsonParsing: STANDARD
      logLevel: VERBOSE
    rules:
    - description: "Block traffic from restricted countries (North Korea, Iran, Syria, Cuba)"
      priority: 1000
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "origin.region_code == 'KP' || origin.region_code == 'IR' || origin.region_code == 'SY' || origin.region_code == 'CU'"
      preview: false
    - description: "Block known malicious IP ranges via Tor exit nodes"
      priority: 1100
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('sourceiplist-tor')"
      preview: false
    - description: "OWASP ProtectionSQL injection"
      priority: 2000
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('sqli-v33-stable')"
      preview: false
    - description: "OWASP Protection - Cross-site scripting (XSS)"
      priority: 2100
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('xss-v33-stable')"
      preview: false
    - description: "OWASP Protection - Local file inclusion"
      priority: 2200
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('lfi-v33-stable')"
      preview: false
    - description: "OWASP Protection - Remote code execution"
      priority: 2300
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('rce-v33-stable')"
      preview: false
    - description: "Rate limit requests per IP - throttle excessive traffic"
      priority: 3000
      action: throttle
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges:
          - "*"
      rateLimitOptions:
        conformAction: allow
        exceedAction: deny(429)
        enforceOnKey: IP
        rateLimitThreshold:
          count: 100
          intervalSec: 60
      preview: false
    - description: "Ban abusive IPs exceeding aggressive rate limits"
      priority: 3100
      action: rate_based_ban
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges:
          - "*"
      rateLimitOptions:
        conformAction: allow
        exceedAction: deny(429)
        enforceOnKey: IP
        rateLimitThreshold:
          count: 1000
          intervalSec: 60
        banDurationSec: 600
        banThreshold:
          count: 2000
          intervalSec: 600
      preview: false
    - description: "Default rule - allow all other traffic"
      priority: 2147483647
      action: allow
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges:
          - "*"
      preview: false

outputs:
- name: securityPolicyName
  value: $(ref.cloud-armor-security-policy.name)
- name: securityPolicySelfLink
  value: $(ref.cloud-armor-security-policy.selfLink)
- name: securityPolicyId
  value: $(ref.cloud-armor-security-policy.id)
